ambiguity.detail: Alexander is mentioned in the cold open flash-forward without prior context for who he is.

verdict.hook_line: The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A noble woman faces a rigged witchcraft trial and prepares to hear her final sentence as her supporters weep.
verdict.why_it_works: The flash-forward conspiracy tease combined with the dramatic gavel slam and impending sentencing creates maximum cliffhanger anxiety.
